title: Luxury Wedding Limo vs. Party Bus: Which Should You Choose in Orange County?
description: Compare luxury wedding limos and party buses to find the best transportation for your Orange County wedding. Learn the pros, costs, and benefits before you book.

blocks.text: Your wedding day is one of the most memorable moments of your life, and every detail matters—including your transportation. From arriving at the ceremony in style to ensuring your guests travel comfortably between venues, choosing the right wedding transportation plays a significant role in creating a stress-free and elegant experience.
